mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate increases the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to lower S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is above 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 7.5% indicates a weak labor market, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 7.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and non-farm payrolls indicates a broad-based economic recovery, which boosts corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and PAYEMS both above their 6-month moving averages
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and PAYEMS are above their 6-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (characterized by rising federal funds rate and persistent inflation above 2.5% YoY), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns due to reduced liquidity and higher cost of capital.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods classified as monetary tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: A higher industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing output, which correlates with improved corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is above its 5-year average.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales (RSAFS) below its 3-month moving average indicates reduced consumer demand, which pressures corporate revenues and results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS is below its 3-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in non-farm payrolls signals a tightening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is declining and PAYEMS is rising.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions (defined by GDPC1 growth above 2.0% YoY and HOUST above 900,000 units), the S&P 500 tends to underperform due to valuation concerns and impending monetary policy tightening.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods classified as late-cycle expansions.
